subject: Acme renewal & expansion call - recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme.com>, Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme renewal & expansion call - recap and next steps

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Below is a short recap of what we covered, the pain areas you called out, and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of current state / goals
- Current Redwood usage: ~1.4B tokens/month (mainly gen) + 60k embeddings/mo.
- Primary pain points: intermittent latency spikes during peak batch windows, unpredictable per-token costs on burst workloads, and a couple of production regressions after recent model swaps.
- Goals for renewal: cost predictability, higher tail performance at peak, and a clear expansion path for retriever/embedding workloads.

Key opportunities we discussed
1) Dedicated (reserved) capacity for production gen workloads to smooth latency and cost — we can provision a pool sized for your 99th percentile throughput and set up autoscaling + burst buffer.
2) Pilot for embeddings + reranking (vector DB + batch embedding flow) to consolidate mixed workloads and reduce multi-provider cost.
3) SLO + rollback policy + canary model switch for safe model upgrades (reduce regression risk).

Data / attachments
- Attached: acme-usage-report-q3.csv (export of recent usage and percentile latency buckets).

Proposed next steps and timeline
- Action for Redwood: I will share a pricing draft and a one-page SOW for a 3-month dedicated pilot by EOD tomorrow (Ben will own pricing).
- Action for Acme: confirm whether procurement needs an NDAs/POC terms upfront and confirm contact for procurement (Jacob, you mentioned Mary Kim).
- Timeline suggestion: pilot kick-off mid-Oct, finalize SOW and pricing by Oct 20, provision Dedicated capacity in early Nov, contract renewal target Dec 15.

If that looks right I’ll loop in Ben (pricing) and Monica (onboarding/solutions) and we’ll send the draft SOW + pricing.

Thanks again — excited to get this moving.
—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. This matches our takeaways. A few clarifications: 
- Renewal window: we’re targeting a decision by mid-December, but procurement will need pricing and a short SOW to start internal review.
- Pilot: we’re happy to run a 3-month pilot for embeddings + reranking; main success metrics will be cost per embed and 95/99 latency during peak query traffic.
- Procurement contact: Jacob will coordinate internally; Mary Kim (mary.kim@acme.com) will be looped for legal/PO review.

Please send the pricing and SOW — we’ll review and aim to get initial comments back within a week.

Thanks,
Olivia
